item.title: US missile hit military base near Iran school, video analysis shows
item.summary: A US Tomahawk missile hit a military base near a primary school in southern Iran where Iranian authorities said 168 people were killed, expert video analysis shows.

item.title: Five Iranian footballers 'in Australian safe house' after Asian Cup protest
item.summary: Concern has grown for team after one critic called them 'wartime traitors' for failing to salute during the Iranian anthem.

item.title: How the Iran war may affect your bills and finances
item.summary: The conflict in the Middle East could raise the cost of petrol, household energy bills and even food.

item.title: Call off King's US visit over Iran, urge Lib Dems
item.summary: The party says the planned trip should be scrapped after Donald Trump's criticism of the UK's response to the war.

item.title: Watch: Why the Iran war is pushing up oil prices
item.summary: As turmoil continues in the Middle East, the price of crude oil rose to more than $100 a barrel on Monday.

item.title: In maps: Ten days of strikes across the Middle East
item.summary: Israel has continued strikes across Iran and Lebanon and the Iranian regime has carried out more attacks, as the war continues for a tenth day.

item.title: Watch: Ukrainian anti-drone 'bullet' that could help defend Gulf
item.summary: The BBC's Diplomatic Correspondent, James Landale, is in Ukraine to see the latest anti-drone technology the country has to offer.

item.title: HMS Prince of Wales unlikely to head to the Middle East
item.summary: It comes after defence sources said the crew had been told they must be ready to leave in five days.

item.title: Images of face released in bid to solve mystery of man found dead in wetsuit
item.summary: Detectives hope the new facial reconstruction images will end an 18-month mystery.

item.title: Ticketmaster owner Live Nation agrees to pay $280m to end US monopoly case
item.summary: The live events company, which owns Ticketmaster, will open parts of its business to rival companies.
